distinction: same-day residential task group != multi-day expedition party

callers.physicalLocation: target within the same-day round-trip budget; the group sleeps at camp
callers.laborAuthority: estimateTaskGroupPeople(band) — a capped SHARE of residential working adults minus expedition commitments, floored at 1
callers.whyLegitimate: the group IS drawn from the residence that day, so residential labour is the correct authority. Unchanged by CORRECTION-34E; it passes no party context.

callers.activityType: multi-day expedition party, operating at its target
callers.physicalLocation: the party's own positionTileId, up to many days from camp
callers.whyLegitimate: the people doing the work are physically standing at the target. Repaired by CORRECTION-34E; previously read residential labour.

callers.activityType: multi-day verification party, looking without taking
callers.whyLegitimate: who looks is the party; the take is suppressed by verifyOnly, not by labour. Repaired by CORRECTION-34E.

callers.activityType: the ONE physical resolver, shared by both paths
callers.laborAuthority: none of its own — consumes record.resourceReturn.estimatedReturnValue as the requested amount
callers.whyLegitimate: deliberately labour-blind so there is exactly one physical harvest equation; correctness therefore depends entirely on the record it is handed, which is why the repair is at the record builder.

callers.laborAuthority: band.demography.workingAdults minus committed expedition productive workers, capped and floored at 1
callers.whyLegitimate: a labour question against a labour cohort. NOT globally replaced: it remains correct for the same-day path and is simply not consulted by the expedition path.
